_comment: Phase B / item 8. sales_consultant.py reads this to decide upsell/cross-sell copy. 'recreate_eligible_if' describes which product_customization_map rows qualify for a Ready-to-Ship -> Custom upsell pitch; actual per-SKU eligibility still lives in the product_customization_map table (filled in later with real data).

upsell_ready_to_custom.eligible_if: product_customization_map.is_customizable = true for the product being viewed/shortlisted
upsell_ready_to_custom.trigger_moment: after a Ready to Ship product is shortlisted or shown in Stylist results
copy_templates: Love this one? You can also get it Custom-made in your size and choice of fabric/color, starting at {custom_price_min}.
This design is available Ready to Ship, or we can recreate it as a Custom piece tailored just for you — want to see that option?
If you'd like something closer to perfect, this style can be recreated as a Custom order with {recreate_note}.

upsell_custom_to_bespoke.eligible_if: avatar_type = 'custom' and style_prefs indicates a highly specific/unique request (e.g. custom motif, heavy personalization mentioned in free text)
upsell_custom_to_bespoke.trigger_moment: when the bride describes a very specific vision that goes beyond standard customization options
copy_templates: What you're describing sounds like it deserves a fully Bespoke piece designed from scratch around your vision — want me to set up a consultation for that?
For something this personal, Bespoke gives our design team full creative freedom to build exactly what you have in mind.

cross_sell_accessories.eligible_if: a core outfit (lehenga/gown/saree) has been shortlisted or added to cart
cross_sell_accessories.trigger_moment: immediately after a core outfit is shortlisted
copy_templates: This would pair beautifully with our {accessory_category} — want to see a few that match this look?
Brides usually complete this look with matching {accessory_category} — want me to show you some options?

consultation_booking_prompt.eligible_if: avatar_type in ('custom', 'bespoke') and 2+ shortlisted products or an unresolved sizing/timeline question
consultation_booking_prompt.trigger_moment: after Stylist stage has produced results for a Custom/Bespoke bride
copy_templates: Would you like to book a quick consultation with our styling team to finalize the details? I can hold a slot for you.
Since this is a Custom piece, a short consultation call really helps get the fit and details exactly right — want me to book one?
